```yaml
name: Codex Review Notify Code Owner

on:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  notify_code_owner:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout repository
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up Node.js
      uses: actions/setup-node@v2
      with:
        node-version: '14'

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: npm install

    - name: Run TypeScript configuration future audit
      run: bun run tsconfig:future-audit

    - name: Check if there are any changes
      id: check_changes
      run: |
        git diff --exit-code || echo "::set-output name=has_changes::true"

    - name: Notify code owner
      if: ${{ github.event.pull_request.user.login == 'codeowner' }}
      run: |
        echo "Code review requested by @${{ github.event.pull_request.user.login }}"
        # Add your notification logic here, e.g., using GitHub API or email
```

Please replace `'codeowner'` with the actual username of the code owner you want to notify. This workflow will notify the code owner when a pull request is opened or updated.
